blocks.x: Tony Fusier used to come around.
Yeah, Tony's a kid. He was here the other day.
Yeah, he was playing in the Famous Doe for a while.
I didn't know that, huh? That's what I heard. No, he was playing with The Last Straws at Pete's place, Pete Fountain's place for a while. Oh, yeah?
I thought he was playing in the Famous Doe. Who's playing there, Nondi? At The Doe? Yeah.
Ruffey Campo, Sharky, and Leon Prima has the off-nines.

Sharky's got a group there? I didn't know that. Yeah. Yeah? Yeah. Look at that. Good Monk and Harry. Yeah? Same old group then. Who's he got on clarinet? Harry. Harry, yeah. Shield. And Trombone. Emil Oliberi. He just mostly kept most of Mike Lawlin's band. Yeah. Where's Mike playing? Spotting. Mike plays nice horn.
No, he's playing at the Happy Landing.

I know, but it's just mostly spot. That's a spot, yeah. Saturday night. Two nights. Saturday and Sunday. It's Frankie Mann's job. He was releasing at the Dream Room too, too. So we were here. So it's really just a spot. Double spot. Mm-hm.
